mapper.insert: insert into push_subscription (user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, language_code) values (#{userId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{languageCode}) on conflict on constraint uq_push_subscription_endpoint do update set user_id = excluded.user_id, p256dh = excluded.p256dh, auth = excluded.auth, language_code = excluded.language_code
mapper.delete: delete from push_subscription where endpoint = #{endpoint} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select s.id, s.user_id, s.endpoint, s.p256dh, s.auth, s.language_code from push_subscription s join user_preference p on p.user_id = s.user_id where p.reminder_enabled = true and p.municipality_id = #{municipalityId}
select id, user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, language_code from push_subscription where user_id = #{userId} order by id asc
